Appearance in the outpost (left) and mission (right) | type = Human | affiliation = Luxons | level = 10, 20 | profession = n | campaign = Factions }} [[Elder Cleo]] is the elder of the [[Luxon]] [[Crab Clan]], along with [[Captain Elora]] as their clan leader, and [[Daeman]] as their champion. ==Locations== *[[The Jade Sea]] **{{NPC location|Boreas Seabed|outpost}} (level 10) ==Missions== *The Jade Sea **{{NPC location|Boreas Seabed}} (level 20) ==Skills== *{{skill icon|Lingering Curse}} (elite) ==Dialogue== In the outpost and mission before defeating the three Champions: :''"[[Zhu Hanuku]]'s death will release a large burst of energy, which we will harness and use to raise our fallen Champions. The sea that was, lends us its power to help facilitate this rebirth."'' In the mission after defeating the three Champions: :''"However strange it may be to relinquish the [[Spear of Archemorus]] to outsiders, we feel that it is best. The spear has five degrees of power, increasing its damage potential with each degree. Each time you drop the spear, it discharges its power and must be infused again."'' ==Notes== {{bug|In the outpost, Elder Cleo uses a female [[skin]]; however, a male skin is used during the mission. This is similar to [[Elder Casta]].}}
